001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.hilt;
002
003import android.content.Context;
004import androidx.room.Room;
005import dagger.Module;
006import dagger.Provides;
007import dagger.hilt.InstallIn;
008import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
009import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.TrackDao;
012import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.UserDao;
013import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.PinDatabase;
014import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.Preloader;
015import javax.inject.Singleton;
016
017@Module
018@InstallIn(SingletonComponent.class)
019public class DatabaseModule {
020//Telling hilt how to get an instance of the database
021  @Provides
022  @Singleton
023  PinDatabase provideDatabase(@ApplicationContext Context context, Preloader callback) {
024    return Room.databaseBuilder(context,
025            PinDatabase.class, PinDatabase.getDatabaseName())
026//        .addCallback(callback)
027        .build();
028  }
029
030  @Provides
031  @Singleton
032  PinDao providePinDao(PinDatabase database) {
033    return database.getPinDao();
034  }
035
036  @Provides
037  @Singleton
038  UserDao provideUserDao(PinDatabase pinDatabase) {
039    return pinDatabase.getUserDao();
040  }
041
042  @Provides
043  @Singleton
044  TrackDao provideTrackDao(PinDatabase pinDatabase) { return pinDatabase.getTrackDao(); }
045
046
047}
